scope: Turkish text for MKAOS training, validation, independent testing, and potential model-weight redistribution
policy: A candidate is not approved until exact release, files, hashes, license scope, attribution, privacy and model-training/weight-distribution terms receive documented human review.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 Turkish sentence text
sources.license_claim: The exact MDC product page identifies cv-corpus-27.0-2026-09-11 Turkish (tr) as CC0-1.0 and forbids re-hosting/re-sharing the dataset. The datasheet says sentence sources are approximately 85.0% Turkish Wikipedia, 11.6% sentence-collector, 1.2% SETimes, and 2.2% Other. Underlying source rights, corpus provenance and resulting model-weight distribution still require review.
review_required: download only through the official authorized MDC flow and keep archive/text TSV outside Git
record SHA-256 for the original archive and exact selected validated_sentences.tsv file
review the datasheet's source breakdown and investigate upstream rights for Wikipedia, SETimes, sentence-collector and Other groups
confirm that the exact text file and intended generative-language-model training use are compatible with applicable dataset terms and upstream rights
document whether distribution of derived MKAOS model weights is permitted; dataset CC0 label alone is not recorded as legal advice
exclude audio, client_id, speaker demographics and other unnecessary metadata from the training corpus
run local duplicate, PII/secrets, source/document split-leakage, and human content review
obtain documented human/legal approval before changing source status or opening training gate
sources.evidence_note: The exact Turkish v27.0 MDC product page is now identified (dataset ID cmu5wkah500c2o10719lem8m8; release date 2026-09-17; datasheet cv-corpus-27.0-2026-09-11). The page says CC0-1.0 and prohibits dataset re-hosting/re-sharing; its source table attributes about 85% of sentences to Turkish Wikipedia. Local archive/TSV hashes are not available in this repository environment, source-specific legal compatibility has not been decided, and weight-distribution approval is pending. Candidate only; not training approval.
sources.candidate_release: Common Voice Scripted Speech v27.0 — Turkish (tr), dataset ID cmu5wkah500c2o10719lem8m8; not approved

review_required: review exact dump and imported-content exceptions
assess training and model-weight distribution obligations

sources.name: Tatoeba Turkish text sentences

review_required: pin exact export and Turkish rows
retain sentence-author attribution for every record
verify training and weight-distribution compatibility

sources.name: HPLT v2.0 cleaned Turkish (tur-Latn)
sources.license_claim: HPLT states the packaging is CC0; it does not own the underlying extracted texts and requires users to comply with applicable law. Official page lists a 426.16 GB cleaned Turkish package.
review_required: pin exact release, download URL, archive size and SHA-256
confirm each underlying source's rights and any source-specific restrictions; CC0 for packaging is not a blanket licence for underlying text
run privacy/PII, secrets, malware and quality screening before retaining any content
define an auditable filtered subset and preserve source/document IDs
obtain written human/legal approval for training and model-weight distribution
sources.evidence_note: Candidate only. Do not download the full 426.16 GB package into Git or treat its packaging licence as clearance for all underlying content.
